CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.analyzeros_cleaning_decisions (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    dataset_id uuid NOT NULL
        REFERENCES public.dealos_datasets(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    column_name text,

    suggestion text NOT NULL,

    decision text NOT NULL
        CHECK (decision IN ('approve', 'ignore', 'edit')),

    user_override text,

    user_id text,
    organization_id text,

    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'recorded',

    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
analyzeros_cleaning_decisions_dataset_idx
ON public.analyzeros_cleaning_decisions (
    dataset_id,
    created_at DESC
);
